g.text: Tagline: See what a carbon claim is really worth.
Value line: Type a company. See the credits it retired, how many research says are likely real, what it reports
emitting, and what independent estimates see.
Headline facts: about 1 in 5 researched tonnes likely real (19.4%, range 2.4–68.8%, flat since 2020); 57% of tonnes
cannot be tied to a named claimant (41% blank); none of the 52 gradable large buyers reaches a B; 4.5% carry the
ICVCM quality label; for 4 of 14 comparable groups the independent estimate is 3–6× reported Scope 1.
Proof line: Every published check is on the record. No one, not even Netra, can edit it.
